subject: Post-demo: procurement & marketplace path (AWS Marketplace)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratocloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & marketplace path (AWS Marketplace)

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay synchronized: 

1) Recap: we showed Redwood Dedicated + Private options for your inference-heavy workflows and the marketplace path (AWS Marketplace) as the preferred commercial channel for some teams. You mentioned SSO requirements and SOC 2 as gating items.

2) Procurement path check: can you confirm whether StratoCloud will:
   - purchase via AWS Marketplace (SaaS contract) OR
   - sign an enterprise contract directly (PO to Redwood)

3) Payment method: do you require PO invoicing or will the card/billing on AWS Marketplace be acceptable? You mentioned legal prefers PO for annual commitments.

4) Timing & blockers: you said procurement aims to complete vendor onboarding by end of October. Can you share procurement contact and any RFP or contract templates?

5) Attachments: attaching the RFP we reviewed and an initial SOW draft for budgeting.

Next steps I suggest:
- Alex: confirm marketplace vs direct PO, procurement contact, and target approval date
- We: share pricing sheet, SOC 2 report, and marketplace listing link + next steps for onboarding

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min sync with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: StratoCloud_RFP.pdf, SOW-draft-StratoCloud.docx

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratocloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stratocloud.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & marketplace path (AWS Marketplace)

Camila — great demo, thanks. Quick answers below: 

- Marketplace vs direct: We prefer AWS Marketplace for ease of procurement for the Platform org, but two business units (Analytics and Security) may want a direct PO for visibility on spend. For the initial rollout, Marketplace is preferred.
- Payment: Procurement prefers PO for any multi-year or >$50k commitments. For annual pilots <$50k, marketplace card billing is acceptable.
- Timing: Procurement estimates vendor onboarding + legal review complete by ~2026-10-29.
- Required docs: SOC 2 Type II, data processing addendum, standard SLAs.

I've looped in procurement (procurement@stratocloud.com) — Sarah Lee is our procurement lead (cc'd). She'll be the one to take the PO or marketplace contract.

I'll get you Sarah's PO template and any internal compliance checklist by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform, StratoCloud
alex.turner@stratocloud.com
+1 (628) 555-0199

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratocloud.com>, Sarah Lee <procurement@stratocloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & marketplace path (AWS Marketplace)

Thanks Alex — and hi Sarah, nice to meet you. 

Sarah, per Alex: attaching the SOC 2 Type II and our standard DPA for your review. Also attaching a short pricing sheet and an editable SOW draft (SOW-draft-StratoCloud.docx) you can use for internal approval. If Marketplace is the preferred path, we can: 

- Publish an AWS Marketplace SaaS listing for Redwood (we already have the listing process documented)
- Work with your procurement to accept marketplace billing for initial pilots <$50k
- Provide a PO invoicing flow for annual contracts or >$50k bundles: we can accept a PO and issue customer invoices (Net 30) if needed — we'll need your PO template and billing contact.

Links: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910
- Example AWS Marketplace listing: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B08EXAMPLE (internal reference)

If you want to go marketplace route, next steps: 
1) Sarah: confirm billing method for pilots vs enterprise rolls and share PO template
2) We: provide finalized pricing + marketplace onboarding checklist + DocuSign if you prefer a signature flow for the SOW

I can schedule a 15-min call with Sarah + Alex + Marissa to finalize route. Does 10/19 or 10/20 morning PT work?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII.pdf, DPA-redwood.pdf, SOW-draft-StratoCloud.docx, Pricing-sheet-StratoCloud.xlsx

From: Sarah Lee <procurement@stratocloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@stratocloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & marketplace path (AWS Marketplace)

Camila — thanks for the materials. Confirming:

- Procurement prefers AWS Marketplace for the pilot (card okay for pilot <$50k).
- For enterprise purchases (> $50k / multi-year) we will issue a PO. Attached is our PO template and compliance checklist.
- Target: vendor onboarding complete and pilot PO/Marketplace billing enabled by 2026-10-29.

Next items from our side: we'll send back the completed PO template if we go direct and will request your billing contact for invoice setup. For the marketplace path, please provide the onboarding checklist and the marketplace listing steps (we'll need the AWS account IDs for purchase visibility).

Procurement contact: Sarah Lee | procurement@stratocloud.com | +1 (415) 555-0210

Thanks — Sarah
